note_on_hashes: Zip SHA-256 is not reproducible across repacks of identical source (embedded per-entry mtimes differ) — confirmed by entry-by-entry byte comparison in revision 0.9's fix pass. A hash mismatch against a prior build's manifest is expected on rebuild and is not itself evidence of content drift; compare via pac solution unpack + diff if content equality needs proving.
